changed:
Multi-step action plans under execution_ir on. Steps:
- The driver step ProposePlan was added and SDK_API_VERSION became 1.1; existing plugin manifests (>=1.0,<2.0) still admit.
- A 2+-step plan is approved once over the plan.v1 digest. Each step's input binds the real rule_bundle_version and policy_version known at proposal.
- A placeholder step that cannot be validated in wire form is refused before approval (KERNEL-PLAN-STEP-UNVALIDATABLE). This covers an ERROR status and any kernel sentinel bundle: kernel-evidence-v1, none or error.
- Steps dispatch in order, each after the previous one is VERIFIED. Run transitions VERIFYING->RUNNING happen only between plan steps.
- Before a later step reserves, the kernel checks:
  - that the stored step matches the approved input: contract, connection, expected_effects, wire-form arguments and step id; a mismatch is STALE (KERNEL-PLAN-STEP-CHANGED);
  - that the approval has not expired;
  - that the facts, the rule bundle and the policy are unchanged; a change is STALE;
  - that the resolved lineage values pass domain validation; a block is STALE.
- Lineage resolves only from VERIFIED OutcomeReport.verified_values. A missing value or a type mismatch stops the plan before the reservation.
- verified_values is stored only in on; off and shadow drop it before record_outcome.
- Approval presentation: plan_steps, highest_risk, irreversible_steps.
- The live guard refuses a multi-write budget.
- CLI plan printing; ERP and notes two-step scripted scenarios; OpenAPI and schema.ts regenerated; the conformance mock carries the new presentation fields.
- New kernel module plan_flow.py.
open_items: 2c.8: an end-to-end test of the plan write budget counting earlier run writes, once a driver turn can follow a verified write. Today the budget is tested at _plan_findings (review R2-3).

In the ERP two-step scenario, step 2's lineage value equals the value step 1 proposed, because the simulator echoes it back. It demonstrates lineage only and is not a procurement scenario, so later evidence must not claim more.
tests/unit/server/test_action_plan_erp.py takes its store from the fixture profile and does not run on Postgres. The kernel plan tests run there through gate pg.
Codex re-check of 2c.6 and 2c.7 after its usage limit resets, before the phase closes.
Owner: re-pin domain-erp and odoo19 in the local live profile before 2d.2; branch protection.

rulings.ruling: verified_values is stored only in on; off and shadow drop it before the store, so off stays byte-identical (ENG-TOGGLE-1, PR-26).
Every step's digest binds the real rule and policy versions known at proposal. A sentinel version never reaches a digest. Resolved values are validated before their step reserves.
A stored step that differs from its approved input stops the plan as STALE, since no INTEGRITY reason code exists.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Reason-code churn if an integrity code is added.

rulings.ruling: The R-4c write-budget guard is tested at the plan check, because it is unreachable end to end today.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A regression there goes unnoticed until the 2c.8 end-to-end test exists.

rulings.ruling: ui-conformance mock-api.ts was added to the scope: the generated schema makes the defaulted presentation fields required.
Codex was limited, so Claude reviewers ran three rounds (opus twice; a fresh sonnet scoped re-review of the tests-only round 2). Each confirmed the new tests by mutation.
